comments: Text tab in a proportional font, so a few notes fall between columns: after 1:0 the string-1 notes 2 and 3 sit half a column off the string-4 0 / string-6 x / string-6 0 notes, so they are separate events. The same thing happens with the last 1:3 and the 6:0 just before the final G chord. The double-headed vertical arrow right after the first G chord is a strum mark and was ignored. '12' and '10' on string 1 are two-digit frets with dashes touching. / A double-headed vertical arrow (strum mark) right after the first six-string chord is not a barline; ignored. '12' and '10' on string 1 are touching digit pairs. No barlines.
